mentions.name: Nintendo DS Portal clone (Rust)
mentions.description: A Portal clone developed in Rust for the Nintendo DS, featuring portal jumps, animations, and level creation, using the DS's basic 3D hardware which makes 3D rendering approachable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I put together a pretty basic portal clone. I think its pretty cool to see it come together, animations, level creation, portal jumps.
